bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 71
p="docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At"
real_count=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics t JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=t.chat_id AND p.message_thread_id=t.message_thread_id WHERE t.enabled=TRUE AND t.purpose='link' AND p.state='published' AND p.pinned=TRUE AND p.message_id IS NOT NULL AND p.token_hash IS NOT NULL")
test "$real_count" = 3 || exit 72
missing_count=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics t LEFT JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=t.chat_id AND p.message_thread_id=t.message_thread_id WHERE t.enabled=TRUE AND (p.chat_id IS NULL OR p.state<>'published' OR p.pinned IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE OR p.message_id IS NULL)")
test "$missing_count" = 0 || exit 73
placeholders=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE title LIKE '(thread:%' AND state='verified' AND pinned=FALSE AND message_id IS NULL")
test "$placeholders" = 15 || exit 74
echo REAL_REGISTERED_LINK_PIN_COUNT="$real_count"
echo REGISTERED_ENABLED_TOPIC_MISSING_PINS="$missing_count"
echo PLACEHOLDERS_UNTOUCHED="$placeholders"
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 75
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" bot_start_menu || exit 76
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 77
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 78
echo TOPIC_ENTRY_COVERAGE_AND_USERBOT_DM=PASS
